resources.title: Object rights
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for OBJECT operation permissions (the SysSchemaOperationRight / "Object permissions" layer): read a role's read/create/edit/delete on an entity with get-object-rights and grant or revoke it with set-object-rights, for ANY role. Covers the object-level vs record-level vs system-operation distinction; making a portal section's object available to external users is one use case.

resources.title: Portal sections
resources.description: Orchestration guide for registering a Freedom UI section so PORTAL (self-service / external) users can open it: sequences page binding, workplace placement, and object-access grant, all carrying the All external users audience, on the deny-by-default external-user model. The Freedom mechanism (SysSchemaOperationRight), not the Classic SSP tables.
